doc: env/set never takes a name the hub's own path rules read (HOME, TMPDIR, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, DRGNX_DIR, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, the XDG and DRGNX folders, DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS): the login shell's overlay reaches only what children inherit, never where the hub puts sockets and scratch folders. A refused name is left out of the answer (not an error) and out of what a job starts with; the name that is not refused is kept.

argv: case "$HOME|$TMPDIR|$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR|$DRGNX_DIR|$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" in *canary*) echo leaked-$MISE_ROW_PROBE;; *) echo clean-$MISE_ROW_PROBE;; esac
